global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: a heavy bold sans for the headline in ALL CAPS, a clean sans for the rest

visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALDROPS. Its bottle reproduced with total fidelity to the attached photo (label, brand name letter by letter, colors).
LAYOUT (hero): Z1 headline across the top; the model full body on the RIGHT side; Z3 benefit bullets on the LEFT; the product bottle at the bottom center; Z5 offer as a ribbon along the bottom.
MODEL: a 36 years old woman, soft, average build, fair skin with freckles, straight hair in a ponytail, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup. Emotion: El frasco al frente, grande y nítido. Detrás, desenfocada, una mujer de 27 años en el balcón de su apartamento al amanecer, con su jugo en la mano. Calma, seguridad, comienzo de día..
SETTING: a beach at golden hour. POSE AND FRAMING: stretching with arms up, three-quarter back view, full body framing.

text_layers.text: VITALDROPS: 5 EN 1 PARA TRABAJAR TUS CURVAS
text_layers.text_style: very bold, ALL CAPS, high contrast, the biggest text

text_layers.reference_position: on or next to the bottle
inside or right below the offer

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo, at least 15% of the image
the woman: a 36 years old woman, soft, average build, fair skin with freckles, straight hair in a ponytail, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
final_generation_exclusions: any text closer than 5% to the edges
medical claims, guarantees or invented numbers
brands or logos other than the product

forbidden_additions: prices other than the given offer

language_rule: All visible text in Colombian Spanish, simple, perfectly spelled.

app_desde0.modelo: a 36 years old woman, soft, average build, fair skin with freckles, straight hair in a ponytail, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
app_desde0.pose: stretching with arms up, three-quarter back view, full body framing
